ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/cream) across ~80% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the margins and central notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the center of both lobes. Black pigmentation is mapped to the entire trailing edge, the leading edge boundaries, the distal tips, and a broad vertical band at the central peduncle junction. Discrete low-intensity spots (mottling) are distributed across the inner white fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression at the center with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and significant depth extending toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations are present along the full extent of the trailing edge, characterized by jagged pixel-level transitions from fluke to water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to the notch, with a convex trajectory on the leading edges tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of white, circular, raised-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) are densely packed on both the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, dark, unaligned linear marks are visible; specifically, three parallel diagonal rake marks on the right lobe and scattered shorter streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips and visible rake mark scarring on the right ventral lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pattern of small, dark, circular pigmentation spots (mottling) scattered throughout the high-intensity white regions of both fluke lobes.
